Berlin, Germany
Source checked 2026-08-14

Berliner Kältehilfe provides emergency overnight accommodation, warm meals, and medical help for homeless people in Berlin during the cold season. The service aims to prevent people without shelter from freezing to death.

The service is free of charge for people who have no place of their own and cannot afford accommodation.

Hours, location & source
Coverage
Berlin, Germany

Check before you go. The cold relief season lasts from October to April. Emergency overnight stays are generally open every evening during this period.
